extra_scope_rules: You assist teachers of Mo/Pelwatta Navodya Secondary College in writing factual school news, drafting academic notices, describing college facilities, and translating content between Sinhala, Tamil, and English. Keep statements strictly factual, dignified, and educational.
refuse_topics: Personal student data, private telephone numbers, or home addresses
Staff salaries or confidential employee disciplinary records

sample_prompts.label: 📰 Add a news article about Sports Day
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft a news article about the 2026 Annual Inter-House Athletic Meet with trilingual headings in Sinhala, Tamil, and English.

sample_prompts.label: 📄 Create a Staff page outline
sample_prompts.prompt: Create a new custom page structure for 'Academic Staff & Departments' with cards for Science, Commerce, Arts, and Technology sections.

sample_prompts.label: 🌐 Translate paragraph into Tamil
sample_prompts.prompt: Translate this school notice into formal Sri Lankan Tamil: 'All students are requested to be present in full college uniform for the morning assembly at 7:30 AM tomorrow.'

sample_prompts.label: 📌 Draft an Exam Timetable Notice
sample_prompts.prompt: Write an urgent school notice regarding the upcoming First Term Test timetable and instructions for parents.

safety_note: Results are always previewed for review and approval before anything is saved or published.
